name: Maldives

fees.name: Tourist visa on arrival (30 days)
fees.notes: Free of charge for all nationalities; granted on arrival, no pre-approval required. Traveller Declaration (IMUGA) must be submitted online within 96 hours before travel and is also free of charge.

fees.name: Tourist visa extension (up to 90 days total)
fees.validity: up to 60 additional days (90 days total)
fees.notes: First 30 days free on arrival; extension of up to 60 further days costs MVR 750, applied for in Male' with a local sponsor. Fee per Maldives Immigration / Maldives Permanent Mission (Geneva).

fees.name: Business visa (multiple entry, 30-90 days)
fees.validity: 30-90 days per grant, max 180 days per calendar year
fees.notes: Applied via Ministry of Economic Development & Trade Business Portal (business.egov.mv). MVR 750 application fee widely published for the Business Visa Regulation (2021); amount not shown on the immigration page itself, so verify on the Business Portal at application time.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Maldives does not operate a tourist e-visa; entry is via free visa on arrival plus the mandatory free IMUGA Traveller Declaration.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No separate paid transit visa; transiting passengers who enter are covered by the free visa on arrival regime.

reciprocity_variations.note: Under the India-Maldives bilateral agreement, Indian nationals visiting for tourism may be granted up to 90 days free on arrival (vs the standard 30 days). Still free of charge.

free_visa_notes: Maldives grants a free 30-day tourist visa on arrival to all nationalities (90 days for Indian nationals under a bilateral agreement). No pre-arrival visa or fee for tourists; only the free IMUGA Traveller Declaration is required. Paid items are the optional MVR 750 in-country extension and the MVR 750 business visa.
